about_the_game:
ZCurse is a survival game with intense action, strategic base-building, and roguelite elements. The undead hordes are endless, your shelter is under siege, and there’s nowhere to escape. Your only choice is to stand your ground and hold out until reinforcements arrive—if they ever do. Gather resources in each run to strengthen your defenses and give the next survivor a fighting chance.

The ultimate test of survival—will your walls hold, or will the curse consume you?

Key Features

  • 🛡 Survive and Build Your Last Defense

    The undead are relentless, and your survival depends on more than just firepower. Construct walls, barriers, and strategic defenses to control enemy movement and fortify your position against the overwhelming horde.

  • 🔄 Roguelite Progression – Grow Stronger Every Run


    Each defeat is just another chance to get stronger. Collect resources, unlock upgrades, and enhance your defenses so that every new attempt brings you closer to ultimate survival. The more you play, the deadlier you become.

  • ⚔ Fast-Paced Combat Meets Tactical Strategy

    It's not just about shooting—it's about how you fight. Reinforce weak spots and make split-second decisions to hold the line against ever-growing waves of zombies. A single mistake could mean the difference between survival and annihilation.

  • 🚁 Hold Out Until Reinforcements Arrive

    Your mission isn’t just to kill zombies—it’s to endure. Every second you survive brings you closer to rescue. But will your defenses last long enough, or will the curse consume you first?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 8 GB VRAM or higher, DirectX 11 or 12 compatible
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
